posts.title: New year's resolutions are arbitrary, and that's okay
posts.description: I used to do new year's resolutions, and then I went through a phase of hating the entire concept. Now I'm back to the other end of the horseshoe: yes, it's arbitrary. Who cares? It's a nice time to take a breather, reflect, and then do some planning. Happy new year!
